missed-enquiry-rescue.name: 01-enquiry
missed-enquiry-rescue.caption: A buyer writes at 21:40, after the office has closed, and gets the price at once from the agency’s own listings

missed-enquiry-rescue.name: 02-questions
missed-enquiry-rescue.caption: Four short questions, one per message: flat size, budget, when they plan to buy, and area

missed-enquiry-rescue.name: 03-slots
missed-enquiry-rescue.caption: It reads the calendar and offers free site-visit times

missed-enquiry-rescue.name: 04-booked
missed-enquiry-rescue.caption: The visit is booked and logged, and a strong lead is passed to a sales person

missed-enquiry-rescue.name: 05-handover
missed-enquiry-rescue.caption: Asked for a better price or about a loan, it does not haggle or advise: a person will call

missed-enquiry-rescue.name: 06-leads
missed-enquiry-rescue.caption: What the sales team sees in the morning: each lead marked hot, warm or cold by a fixed rule, with the reason

missed-enquiry-rescue.name: 07-reminder
missed-enquiry-rescue.caption: A reminder the day before the visit, and one friendly nudge for a buyer who went quiet

proposal-drafter.name: 01-brief
proposal-drafter.caption: A new client fills in a short brief on the studio’s website, in their own words

proposal-drafter.name: 02-received
proposal-drafter.caption: They get a reference straight away. Behind the scenes, the assistant lists the work asked for, without any prices

proposal-drafter.name: 03-draft
proposal-drafter.caption: The assistant drafts the wording: what we heard, what we will make, and questions before we start

proposal-drafter.name: 04-price
proposal-drafter.caption: Every price comes from the studio’s own rate card by fixed rules. What is not on the card is left for a person

proposal-drafter.name: 05-decision
proposal-drafter.caption: The owner decides: approve and send, approve with changes, or do not send

proposal-drafter.name: 06-log
proposal-drafter.caption: Every proposal is logged with the owner’s decision. A vague brief stops with the owner and nothing goes out

proposal-drafter.name: 07-follow-up
proposal-drafter.caption: Three working days without a reply, a follow-up draft waits for the owner. It never goes out by itself

trial-class-desk.name: 01-ask
trial-class-desk.caption: Someone asks about evening classes and prices, and gets answers from the studio’s own timetable and price list

trial-class-desk.name: 02-booked
trial-class-desk.caption: A trial seat is checked and booked, with the time and what to bring

trial-class-desk.name: 03-health
trial-class-desk.caption: A health question gets a fixed reply before any AI runs: a coach calls first, no advice given

trial-class-desk.name: 05-register
trial-class-desk.caption: After class, the coach marks who came. The system never guesses

trial-class-desk.name: 06-follow-up
trial-class-desk.caption: A thank-you for whoever came, one try-again invite for whoever did not, and a nudge to the coach for anyone not marked
